caption:
After a weekend of gardening, Mr Turtle's finger catches and clicks every time he makes a fist. It may be what's often called trigger finger.

It happens when a finger tendon doesn't glide smoothly through its tunnel at the base of the finger, and it's often stiffest in the morning. Early on, a few things tend to help: easing off long, hard gripping, padding handles, breaking up tasks, and gentle finger movements in warm water. For some people, a small splint worn overnight can help too.

A finger that locks and won't straighten, or turns hot, red and swollen, needs prompt attention. Our Sydney CBD and Chatswood physios can assess your hand. Book online via the link in bio.

caption:
Momo's back is stiff and she's wondering whether to skip yoga. For most everyday back pain, gentle movement tends to help more than rest, and yoga is easy to slow down and adapt.

A simple rule: mild discomfort that settles within a day is usually fine. Sharp pain in a pose, or feeling clearly worse next morning, means scale that pose back next time. Try forward folds with bent knees and blocks, a small sphinx instead of big backbends, and child's pose with a pillow under your chest.

Leg pain, numbness or weakness are worth an assessment, and any bladder or bowel change needs a doctor straight away. Our Sydney CBD and Chatswood physios can help. Book online via the link in bio.

caption:
Mr Turtle sat under the air-con all day and now his neck won't turn. There isn't strong evidence that a cold draught alone causes it. Feeling chilly does make you hunch and hold still, though.

Lulu's new goal is the rowing machine, but after a few sessions his back is feeling it.

The erg is a great full-body workout, but technique matters. Common reasons for a sore back are pulling with the arms first, slumping through the lower back, cranking the damper up and doing too much too soon.

Try this: legs, then body, then arms on the drive. Hinge from the hips with a tall chest, keep the damper around the middle and add about five minutes each week.

하루 종일 같은 자세로 앉아 있다 보니 저녁만 되면 허리가 뻣뻣한 거북씨.

몇 시간씩 앉거나 서거나 운전하면 저녁엔 허리가 당기고 뻐근할 수 있어요. 보통은 다친 신호라기보다 자세를 바꿔 달라는 신호예요.

30~45분마다 자세를 바꾸고, 전화는 서서 받고, 계단을 이용해요. 저녁엔 무릎 흔들기, 캣카우, 가벼운 산책으로 5분 풀어봐요.

다리 저림·힘 빠짐, 대소변 변화, 열이나 이유 없는 체중 감소가 있으면 바로 진료받으세요. 하이브리드 피지오 카이로프랙터가 조정과 운동, 생활 습관을 함께 봐드려요. 프로필 링크에서 온라인 예약 🐢

Toto's training is going well, but a stiff mid-back is stopping his arms going fully overhead.

When stiffness blocks training, hands-on care can often help it feel easier in the short term. That's the window to move: the exercises you do afterwards help you hold onto the change.

Most training niggles come from doing a bit too much, too soon, so your chiropractor should ask about your training week, not just your spine. At Hybrid Physio our chiropractors work alongside physios, Pilates and remedial massage, and refer in-house when that suits you better.
